verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms CrewAI serves an llms.txt index (HTTP 200) and markdown versions of doc pages that point agents back to that index. First-party docs also offer a ready-to-paste setup prompt for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or other coding agents that installs the official CrewAI skills and points the agent at the right docs. missing for 10: independent/community corroboration of agents successfully consuming these docs in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.crewai.com/llms.txt # CrewAI
Fetch the complete documentation index at: https://docs.crewai.com/llms.txt

Copy a ready-to-paste setup prompt for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or any coding agent. It installs the official CrewAI skills, checks the CLI, and points the agent at the right docs before it edits code.
